verdict.rationale: Expensify documents 'Smart Limits on cards' and automated approval of expenses, so the card-limit and approval parts of the story have thin first-party support. Nothing shows budgets allocated to teams or projects, or limits and approvals tied to such budgets. Missing for 10: budget allocation to teams/projects, enforcement of budgets through card limits and approval rules, detailed docs on how Smart Limits work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them

citations.quote: Control spend, automate compliance, and eliminate reimbursements.
Automatically create, submit, approve, and reimburse expenses.
